method: Repository MCP server, normal UI/keyboard/camera controls and bounded simulation waits in isolated saves; no coordinate setting, crew acknowledgement injection or ambient actor relocation. Normal resident schedules and vehicle traffic run.

completeLoadedVoyage.provenance: The completed compiled voyage preceded the final warm-cooling interlock, notice wording and paired-handler timing correction. Those final changes passed the final 205-test source gate and final compiled boot/package gate; final paired-handler behaviour was also walked separately below.

walkingAboard.note: Movement during passage includes both ship displacement and normal relative foot movement.
